name: Mariquita (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, white and green, the white charged with the municipal arms of Mariquita.
history: Municipal flag of Mariquita, a municipality in the department of Tolima, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Mariquita arms — green shield within a yellow border
